query:
SELECT rivalry_groups.id 
FROM rivalry_groups 
WHERE rivalry_groups.week_start = 1 AND rivalry_groups.contract_key = 'index-probe' AND rivalry_groups.skill_band = 0 AND rivalry_groups.member_count < 20 ORDER BY rivalry_groups.created_at, rivalry_groups.id
 LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0
plan: SEARCH rivalry_groups USING INDEX ix_rivalry_open_matching (week_start=? AND contract_key=? AND skill_band=?)
